description: Defines the android::FrameTracker class, which tracks information about recently rendered frames, including timing and fencing details, using a circular buffer. It provides methods for setting frame timing, advancing frames, clearing and retrieving stats, and processing fences.

classes.name: FrameTracker
classes.description: Tracks recent frame timing information, manages a circular buffer of frame records, and handles fence synchronization for frame presentation timing.

methods.name: setDesiredPresentTime
methods.description: Sets the target presentation time for the current frame.

methods.name: setFrameReadyTime
methods.description: Sets the time when the current frame became ready.

methods.name: setFrameReadyFence
methods.description: Sets a fence to determine when the frame is ready.

methods.name: setActualPresentTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the frame was actually presented.

methods.name: setActualPresentFence
methods.description: Sets a fence to determine when the frame was presented.

methods.name: setDisplayRefreshPeriod
methods.description: Sets the display's refresh period in nanoseconds.

methods.name: advanceFrame
methods.description: Advances to the next frame in the buffer.

methods.name: logAndResetStats
methods.description: Logs current stats and resets them.

methods.name: dumpStats
methods.description: Appends frame timing history to a string.
